prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A simple fish silhouette arched slightly, a single flat solid shape,
no scales, no interior detail — pure iconography.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon centered on off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding, modern UI register, sharp vector geometry. A single bold fish silhouette arched in a gentle upward curve, rendered as one clean solid shape in burnt sienna (#D97742), the body tapering to a forked tail and a pointed snout. No scales, no fins rendered as strokes, no interior detail — pure reduced iconography, every edge crisp and deliberate. One small flat eye shape in deep charcoal (#0B0F14) as the sole secondary mark. Flat fill, zero gradients, zero texture, zero brushwork. Silhouette fully readable at 16px.
